high_level_description: This image shows a clothing store display featuring a sleeveless top hanging on a hanger. The top is cream-colored with black mesh panels on the sides, giving it a modern and stylish look. It appears to be a men's tank top, as indicated by the size tag which reads "XL" (Extra Large). The price tag attached to the hanger indicates the price of ₹790. The setting is indoors, likely within a retail store, as evidenced by the metal rack holding multiple hangers with various garments. The floor is made of speckled terrazzo, a common material in retail spaces for its durability and aesthetic
